phase: 55 E-MLB with the gate closed, the configuration LED selects
purpose: Phase 54 rejects the correlation-sign gate on labelled recorded noise. This re-measures the held-out E-MLB rows with the gate closed, so the adopted configuration rests on a measurement rather than on the gate being nearly inert here
why_pairing_should_be_complete: both arms are our own implementation at one frozen retention, so each should be defined wherever the raw stream is, and the complete-case bias that forced the n = 8 headline for the EDformer contrast (phase25 BIAS_WARNING) should not arise. `dropouts` tests that rather than assuming it: sequences whose RAW MESR is non-finite are unusable for every arm and cannot bias a paired contrast, while any sequence lost to a SINGLE arm is counted and named separately. Read `pairing_is_complete` before relying on the clustered intervals

arms.support_gated: beta*G - log(1 + S_r2); the adopted score (anchor)
arms.support_beta0: -log(1 + S_r2); ranking by the 5-bit integer S alone

gate: beta = 1 iff corr(G, R_same_r1) < 0 in the two gated arms; the two beta0 arms ignore the decision entirely
unit_of_analysis: scene within cell; the three reps of a scene are repeated measures of one recording and are averaged before clustering
